FisicaBitDS18B20.codigoError: Last error code: 0 = no error, 1 = probe not connected (check wiring and the 4.7 kΩ resistor), 2 = conversion did not start, 3 = corrupted data (CRC), 4 = timeout.

FisicaBitDS18B20.fijarResolucion: Probe resolution: more bits = finer but slower. 9 bits: 0.5 °C in 94 ms · 10 bits: 0.25 °C in 188 ms · 11 bits: 0.125 °C in 375 ms · 12 bits: 0.0625 °C in 750 ms (default). To stream to fisicabit.com faster than once per second use 9 or 10 bits.
FisicaBitDS18B20.lecturaValida: True if the last reading was valid (probe present and CRC correct).
FisicaBitDS18B20.temperatura:
Reads the temperature of the DS18B20 probe on the pin. Accuracy ±0.5 °C, resolution 0.06 °C (12 bits). A reading takes up to 750 ms; on failure it returns the last valid temperature (0 if there was none).

Wiring: red → 3V, black → GND, yellow (DATA) → P0, 4.7 kΩ resistor between DATA and 3V.

Example (calorimetry): [forever] → [send to fisicabit.com time and (DS18B20 temperature on P0 in °C) every 1000 ms]
FisicaBitDS18B20.temperatura|param|pin: Digital pin where DATA is connected
FisicaBitDS18B20.ultimaTemperatura: Last valid temperature read, without querying the probe again. Useful to send the same value in several units or to show it on the display without waiting for another conversion.

FisicaBitToF.tofDistancia:
Measures distance with a ToF laser module in ONE block: choose the module, say which pins it is wired to and the unit. It initialises itself on first use (and retries if the sensor does not answer), applies a median filter and, if a reading fails, returns the last valid one.

Suggested pins on a micro:bit expansion kit:
  1st sensor: SDA P20 (pin "SDA"/"20") and SCL P19 ("SCL"/"19") = hardware I2C bus, the fastest. VCC → 3V, GND → GND.
  2nd sensor: SDA P14 and SCL P13 · 3rd sensor: SDA P16 and SCL P15 (the modules share address 0x29, so each extra sensor needs its own pin pair).

Example (uniform motion on a rail): [forever] → [send to fisicabit.com time and (ToF distance [TOF200C] SDA [P20] SCL [P19] in [cm]) every 50 ms]
FisicaBitToF.tofDistancia|param|scl: Pin wired to the module's SCL
FisicaBitToF.tofDistancia|param|sda: Pin wired to the module's SDA
FisicaBitToF.tofDistancia|param|unidad: Unit: cm (1 decimal), mm or inches
FisicaBitToF.tofHaySensor: True if a ToF module answers on the given pins.
FisicaBitToF.tofHaySensor|param|scl: Pin wired to the module's SCL
FisicaBitToF.tofHaySensor|param|sda: Pin wired to the module's SDA
FisicaBitToF.tofModuloDetectado: Module detected on the given pins, reading the chip identity: "TOF050C (VL6180X)", "TOF200C / GY-VL53L0XV2 (VL53L0X)", "TOF400C (VL53L1X)" or "none" if nothing answers (check VCC, GND and that SDA/SCL are not swapped).
FisicaBitToF.tofModuloDetectado|param|sc: Pin wired to the module's SCL
FisicaBitToF.tofModuloDetectado|param|sd: Pin wired to the module's SDA
FisicaBitToF.tofPinesSugeridos: Suggested pins for sensor number 1, 2 or 3 on a micro:bit expansion kit, as text (e.g. "SDA P20 SCL P19"). Show it on the display or send it over USB to know where to wire.
